scripts.dev: concurrently --names shared,api,web --prefix-colors gray,blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w @tc/shared" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tc/shared && npm run build -w @tc/api && npm run build -w @tc/web
scripts.tunnel: NGROK_UPSTREAM=host.docker.internal:4000 docker compose --profile tunnel up ngrok
